title: Scholarship
description: One Swedish scholarship. One file per scholarship, in data/scholarships/<id>.json

id.description: Slug identifying the scholarship. Must match the filename without .json.

name.description: The scholarship's official name, as the awarding body writes it.

url.description: Link to the page a student applies from, as specific as possible.

opens.description: Date the application window opens, YYYY-MM-DD. null if not published.

deadline.description: Application deadline, YYYY-MM-DD. null when the scholarship is rolling.

recurrence.description: annual: returns each year on roughly this date. rolling: apply any time. one-off: will not return.

apply_email.description: Only for apply_via 'email', and only an organisational address, never a private individual's.

report_required.description: True when recipients must report back on how the money was used.

typical_amount_sek.description: A typical grant in SEK, where known. Indicative, not a promise.

tags.description: Facets used for filtering. Add a new tag to the schema in the same pull request that first uses it.

notes.description: Short, factual note about eligibility or process. Public facts only.

status.description: Set to 'discontinued' rather than deleting the file when a scholarship stops existing.

last_verified.description: Date someone last checked this entry against the source. Update it whenever you touch the entry.
